title: SimBench-BW suite results
description: Aggregate per-row result record produced by run_suite.py. Every row written here has a sibling measurement_manifest.json; rows carry a status field whose value is one of unsupported / build_failed / correctness_failed / sampled / native. Vendor-control rows appear under vendor_control_only and do not count toward subsystem coverage.

git_commit.description: Repo git commit the run was produced from. Frozen for release-tag reproducibility.

vendor_control_only.description: Vendor-library control rows reported separately and excluded from headline scoring and subsystem-coverage counts.

platform.description: Release-gating platform or `dry_run_cpu` for artifacts emitted by `run_suite.py --dry-run-cpu`. The latter is never promoted to scored status on a reporting platform; it exists so AC32 non-hardware harness plumbing can emit a schema-valid suite_results.json under --component-strict even on hosts without a real GPU probe.

status.description: Execution-outcome status. scaffold is a roster-lifecycle state and does not appear in execution results; a row in scaffold state is simply omitted from suite_results.json.

component_health.description: L4 pipeline rows: per-component pass/fail and checkpoint-artifact references. Absent for non-L4 rows.

measurement_manifest_path.description: Relative path to the sibling measurement_manifest.json.

reason.description: For non-native statuses, a short machine-readable cause (e.g. sm_120a_only, nvcc_error, tolerance_exceeded, trace_shape_overbudget).
